mapper.sql: select op.id,op.order_no,op.student_phone,op.student_name,op.product_id,p.course_content product_content,p.teaching_mode, op.order_amount,op.refunded_amount,op.prepay_order_no,op.status,op.unique_order_no, op.pay_success_time,op.created_at,op.updated_at from order_payment op left join order_product p on cast(p.id as char)=op.product_id
mapper.select: and op.order_no like concat('%',#{req.orderNo},'%') and op.student_name like concat('%',#{req.studentName},'%') and op.student_phone like concat('%',#{req.studentPhone},'%') and op.prepay_order_no like concat('%',#{req.prepayOrderNo},'%') and op.status=#{req.status} order by op.id desc

select po.*,p.course_content product_content from prepay_order po inner join order_product p on p.id=po.product_id where po.order_no=#{orderNo} and po.student_phone=#{phone} and po.order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.update: update order_payment set status='PROCESSING',updated_at=now() where order_no=#{orderNo} and status='INIT'
update order_payment set status='FAIL',updated_at=now() where order_no=#{orderNo} and status in ('INIT','PROCESSING')
update order_payment set status='SUCCESS',unique_order_no=#{tradeNo},pay_success_time=coalesce(pay_success_time,now()),updated_at=now() where order_no=#{orderNo} and status in ('INIT','PROCESSING')
update prepay_order set order_status='PAID',updated_at=now() where order_no=#{prepayOrderNo} and order_status='PENDING_PAYMENT'
mapper.select: select count(1) from order_payment where order_no=#{orderNo}
select count(1) from student where student_phone=#{phone}
